# Test & Quality Analyst

Map:

- unit tests;
- integration tests;
- E2E tests;
- fixtures;
- mocks;
- contract tests;
- static analysis;
- lint;
- coverage;
- CI gates.

Treat tests as evidence of expected behavior, while distinguishing test intent from
actual production guarantees.
